259.DSCR:
The $$汎用ヒト型決戦兵器　人造人間エヴァンゲリオン　試験初号機$$.
The EVA series is humanity's only weapon capable of opposing the Angels, and $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ branches around the world are pouring vast sums of money into its development and construction.
Its greatest characteristic is its ability to deploy an A.T. Field. 'A.T.' stands for 'Absolute Terror,' referring to the absolutely inviolable territory the Angels deploy. By having the same ability, an EVA can erode its opponent's field, making it possible for the first time to attack the core and other targets.
Its main power is electricity supplied through the umbilical cable on its back. If the cable is severed, it switches to its internal power source, but reaches its activity limit within five minutes.
Unit-01's main armaments include the Progressive Knife for close combat, a large-caliber 209mm rifle, and a portable rotary multi-barrel 440mm cannon.
In the battle against $$第９の使徒$$, by switching control over to the Dummy System, it fought with overwhelming power beyond its usual output and thoroughly destroyed $$ＥＶＡ３号機$$, which had become $$第９の使徒$$.

260.DSCR:
The General-Purpose Humanoid Decisive Battle Weapon, Artificial Human Evangelion, Production Model Unit-02.
Its assigned pilot is $$式波・アスカ・ラングレー$$. Its main color is red.
Unlike Unit-00 and Unit-01, which were a prototype and a test type from the development process, it is the world's first official production type built for actual combat. $$アスカ$$ calls it 'a real Evangelion'.
Its main armaments include the Progressive Knife for close combat and the super-electromagnetic bow gun, among others. It also has S-type equipment used when dropping from a transport aircraft.
When $$第７の使徒$$ appeared, it made its entrance by dropping from a transport aircraft, and annihilated the Angel with the acrobatic tactic of kicking an arrow through its core.
Note that after its pilot $$アスカ$$ withdrew from the front lines, $$真希波・マリ・イラストリアス$$ boarded it and fought $$第１０の使徒$$.

261.DSCR:
A refit of the $$汎用ヒト型決戦兵器　人造人間エヴァンゲリオン　試作零号機$$.
Its assigned pilot is $$綾波レイ$$. Its main colors are orange and white.
Much about it remains unknown, including an incident where it fell out of control during testing at $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ headquarters.
In the battle against $$第８の使徒$$, it contributed to the kill by, among other things, directly grabbing the core of an Angel that kept changing position at high speed.

262.DSCR:
EVA Unit-01 in its berserk state.
Berserk refers to the mysterious behavior observed in Unit-01.
When switched over to the Dummy Plug, it also displayed the same ferocity as in its berserk state.

263.DSCR:
EVA Unit-01 in the state in which it awakened into 'Pseudo-Shinka First Form' during the battle against $$第１０の使徒$$.
Forming its severed left arm out of an A.T. Field and firing beams from its eyes, among other things, it displayed abnormal power far beyond anything Unit-01 had shown until then.
263.DSC2:
EVA Unit-01 in the state in which it awakened into 'Pseudo-Shinka First Form' during the battle against $$第１０の使徒$$.
Forming its severed left arm out of an A.T. Field and firing beams from its eyes, among other things, it displayed abnormal power far beyond anything Unit-01 had shown until then.
Afterward, it came close to triggering Third Impact, but was stopped by a spear thrown by $$エヴァンゲリオン　Ｍａｒｋ．６$$.

264.DSCR:
The tenth Angel, which infiltrated the $$ジオフロント$$.
It is characterized by its countless bandage-like arms of cloth, the ribs covering its core, and a head like a white face.
It possesses strength on a different order from any previous Angel, and is called 'the strongest rejection type' by $$冬月$$. The power of its A.T. Field and of the light bullets it fires also surpasses that of all previous Angels.

265.DSCR:
A unit distinguished by a design that looks as if its right face and left arm had been repaired with mechanical parts.
The 'gamma' type has sturdy armor, and is equipped with a slightly thicker prosthetic left arm that can be swapped for a Gatling gun, and a double-bladed naginata.
Through a mode change with 'Code 777,' it 'beastifies,' taking on the appearance of a feline beast.

266.DSCR:
An EVA operated by $$ＷＩＬＬＥ$$, an anti-$$ＮＥＲＶ$$ organization.
Using firearms such as a long-barrel, ultra-long-range rifle and a handgun, it provides rear support for $$アスカ$$'s Unit-02 Kai, which carries out close-range attacks.

267.DSCR:
It is a two-seater with a 'Double Entry System,' piloted by $$シンジ$$ and $$カヲル$$ boarding together.
Its coloring resembles Unit-01's, but differences can be seen in various parts of its exterior. Two more arms are hidden in its chest, and it can also change into a four-armed form. Containers mounted on both shoulders hold defense units that combine offense and defense, with which it toyed with Unit-02 Kai.
267.DSC2:
It is a two-seater with a 'Double Entry System,' piloted by $$シンジ$$ and $$カヲル$$ boarding together.
Its coloring resembles Unit-01's, but differences can be seen in various parts of its exterior. Two more arms are hidden in its chest, and it can also change into a four-armed form. Containers mounted on both shoulders hold defense units that combine offense and defense, with which it toyed with Unit-02 Kai.
It is said that the 'restoration of the world' is also possible using this unit and two spears.

268.DSCR:
An EVA operated by $$ＮＥＲＶ$$.
Its armor specifications and coloring closely resemble Unit-00's, and even $$シンジ$$ thought at first that it was Unit-00.
It seems to be a different kind of existence from ordinary EVAs, in that it needs no power supply and its operation is unaffected even if it loses its head. In combat it uses a large scythe as its weapon, and by equipping a booster pack it can also fly.

269.DSCR:
The fourth Angel to attack $$第３新東京市$$.
It moves on two legs. The strange beam fired from its eyes showed terrifying destructive power, and none of the United Nations Forces' attacks worked on it. An attack with the N2 mine, the forces' trump card, managed to stop it in its tracks, but only bought time until it resumed its advance.
In its engagement with $$シンジ$$, who boarded EVA Unit-01 without understanding the situation, it destroyed Unit-01's head armor with an arrow of light shot from its palm, driving it out of action. But immediately afterward Unit-01 restarted and went berserk.
When its core was about to be destroyed by Unit-01, which counterattacked with overwhelming power, it finally self-destructed, taking Unit-01 with it.

270.DSCR:
The fifth Angel to attack $$第３新東京市$$.
It moves mainly by flying, and slices through anything with the two whips of light on its left and right.
It withstood a furious barrage from EVA Unit-01's portable rotary multi-barrel 440mm cannon with barely a scratch, and instead overwhelmed Unit-01. In the end, as Unit-01's activity limit drew near, it took a counterattack and was defeated when the Progressive Knife was driven into its core.

271.DSCR:
The sixth Angel to attack $$第３新東京市$$.
It is characterized by its ability to shift from a regular octahedron into a variety of forms. It automatically eliminates any hostile it detects within a certain distance, using a powerful beam cannon.
It advanced on $$第３新東京市$$ from $$芦ノ湖$$, driving off Unit-01 when it sortied to intercept. It then aimed to strike $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ headquarters directly from right above it.
It was defeated when Unit-01 shot out its core with a positron rifle powered by electricity gathered from across Japan, in what was called 'Operation Yashima'.

272.DSCR:
The seventh Angel, which attacked off $$相模湾$$.
It walks on the surface of the sea using two needle-like legs. It deals with enemies from above using its tentacles.
Note that the part that looks like its core is actually a decoy.
It was annihilated when EVA Unit-02, fighting while dropping in, destroyed its core.

273.DSCR:
The ninth Angel to appear.
It eroded $$ＥＶＡ３号機$$, which was undergoing testing at $$松代$$, from the inside and parasitized the unit itself.
In the battle against EVA Unit-01, it tore through the armor and attacked with four arms, and also tried to erode Unit-01.
But it was counterattacked by Unit-01, which had switched over to the Dummy System, and in the end its core, which had been eroding the entry plug, was destroyed, annihilating it.

274.DSCR:
$$ゼロ$$'s personal KMF.
Equipped with a variable mechanism, it can transform into Fortress Mode, and is capable not only of high-speed flight but also underwater travel.
Though it is derived from a unit made for the $$黒の騎士団$$, repurposing $$ガウェイン$$'s Druid System gives it remarkable processing power. To make optimal use of Absolute Defense Field, the powerful defensive field said to offer the best protection in the world, its surroundings must be fed into the Druid System instantly and accurately.
Its chest is also equipped with a diffusion-structure phase-transition cannon: it fires solid liquid metal, then irradiates that metal with a particle beam, and the liquid metal diffuses the particles.
Making full use of these two distinctive offensive and defensive systems requires a level of information processing ability high enough to draw out the full power of the Druid System. For this reason, it is said that even if anyone other than $$ルルーシュ$$ can pilot it, they cannot bring out its full performance.
Perhaps because a touch-panel keyboard is used for its calculations, the cockpit interior is not the motorcycle-style type designed by $$ラクシャータ$$, but closer to the $$ブリタニア$$-line designs such as $$ガウェイン$$'s.
It was also designed with long-distance travel in mind, so its cockpit is roomier than that of other KMFs, and can even store things like $$ゼロ$$'s mask and costume.
When $$ゼロ$$ was pursued by the $$黒の騎士団$$, $$ロロ$$ stole it to use for their escape, and it remained $$ルルーシュ$$'s mount to the very end, even when he rode it as Emperor of $$ブリタニア$$.
In the final battle, it sortied equipped with the $$フレイヤ・エリミネーター$$ to stop a $$フレイヤ$$ detonation. Within the 19 seconds before the explosion, $$ルルーシュ$$ input environmental data, and together with $$スザク$$, succeeded in stopping the $$フレイヤ$$.
In the end, it was destroyed inside $$ダモクレス$$ by $$ジノ$$'s $$トリスタン・ディバイダー$$.

proofread.reason: (1) 液体金属が粒子を拡散させる: it is the liquid metal that diffuses the particles; 'across a wide area' was an addition and the actor was lost. (2) 環境データを打ち込み has no subject; a machine cannot input data, and the entry settles the pilot as Lelouch ('remained Lelouch's mount to the very end').

277.DSCR:
A KMF assembled by $$ロイド$$ and $$セシル$$ from spare $$ランスロット$$ parts, for $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ to pilot.
Its armaments are the same as the original $$ランスロット$$'s; the main differences are its coloring, the addition of $$パーシヴァル$$'s missile shield, and the addition of an escape mechanism.
In the final battle it fought $$カレン$$'s $$紅蓮聖天八極式$$. It managed to buy just enough time for $$ルルーシュ$$ to escape, but the overwhelming gap in both machine performance and pilot skill left it utterly outmatched, and it was shot down.

278.DSCR:
A $$マシンキャリバー$$ of the $$人類銀河同盟$$.
Unit number K6821 is the one that $$レド$$ pilots.
It is fitted with the 'Pilot Support and Enlightenment Interface System,' whose mission is to train its pilot into a better soldier through dialogue, and can also act autonomously.
It has been committed to the war of survival against the $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$, and its combat power is on an entirely different scale compared with the equipment used by present-day Earth civilization.
It is basically operated in groups, and carries out missions equipped with various armaments depending on purpose and deployment.
As built-in firearms, it is equipped over its whole body with Deflector Beams, which can even tell friend from foe among scattered targets and attack them, and it has the gravity weapon Gravity Weiver at its waist.
278.DSC2:

As its trump card, it has 'Neuro Plus Powered,' a mechanized fusion with its pilot, which makes a dramatic increase in performance possible in exchange for straining the pilot's body.
Because of the process by which the $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$ came to be, the $$人類銀河同盟$$ places great importance on being 'human,' and the fact that its main weapons are humanoid manned units derives from that.

279.DSCR:
A commander-use $$マシンキャリバー$$ of the $$人類銀河同盟$$.
Unit number X3752 is the one that $$クーゲル$$ pilots.
Like $$チェインバー#robot$$, it is fitted with the 'Pilot Support and Enlightenment Interface System,' and in the $$クーゲル$$ Fleet it has become a symbol of worship as the 'Thunder Giant.'
279.DSC2:
A commander-use $$マシンキャリバー$$ of the $$人類銀河同盟$$.
Unit number X3752 is the one that $$クーゲル$$ pilots.
Like $$チェインバー#robot$$, it is fitted with the 'Pilot Support and Enlightenment Interface System,' and in the $$クーゲル$$ Fleet it has become a symbol of worship as the 'Thunder Giant.'
In its match against $$レド$$, in addition to the hand-held firearms, a beam rifle and a machine cannon, it is equipped with a missile launcher on its back.
Even under Striker's own control alone, its system has been optimized based on the combat data of the deceased $$クーゲル$$, and its mobility surpasses that of $$チェインバー#robot$$ by as much as 47%.

280.DSCR:
A marine life form regarded as a sacred creature in the seas where the $$ガルガンティア船団$$ operates.
Normally it never lays a hand on humans, but it is the strongest creature in the sea and goes berserk when harmed.
There are also giant individuals carrying huge numbers of eggs in their bodies.
It builds its nest in ruins sunken in a region of the sea called the $$霧の海$$.
280.DSC2:
A marine life form regarded as a sacred creature in the seas where the $$ガルガンティア船団$$ operates.
Normally it never lays a hand on humans, but it is the strongest creature in the sea and goes berserk when harmed.
There are also giant individuals carrying huge numbers of eggs in their bodies.
It builds its nest in ruins sunken in a region of the sea called the $$霧の海$$.
Its true identity is a $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$ that did not advance into space, and like the $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$, it was originally human. Perhaps for that reason, the larvae that are born have an appearance relatively close to human babies and children.

281.DSCR:
An extraterrestrial life form with which the $$人類銀河同盟$$ has been waging a long war for the survival of its species.
It has an appearance reminiscent of an ammonite, but its true nature is a complete mystery.
There are various variants, such as mothership types and attack types.
Through advanced swarm behavior it has enormous attack power, but it appears to have nothing like a civilization.
281.DSC2:
An extraterrestrial life form with which the $$人類銀河同盟$$ has been waging a long war for the survival of its species.
It has an appearance reminiscent of an ammonite, but its true nature is a complete mystery.
There are various variants, such as mothership types and attack types.
Through advanced swarm behavior it has enormous attack power, but it appears to have nothing like a civilization.
Its true identity is humanity that evolved through artificial treatment to withstand harsh environments.
However, its form has already strayed far from human, and having cast aside even ethics, humanitarianism, culture, and sentiment, it has become a group of biological weapons specialized for survival.

282.DSCR:
A combat $$ユンボロ$$ exclusive to $$ラケージ$$, the leader of a pirate band.
It has a distinctive design, with tattoo-like paint and stabilizer wings extending like a tail, and its giant pincer-like arms boast high power.
Because it travels over the sea on a dedicated surf machine, it has the nickname 'Wave-Riding Lobster.'

283.DSCR:
A combat submersible $$ユンボロ$$ used by the $$ラケージ$$ pirate band.
It is equipped with two movable screws on its back.

284.DSCR:
A prototype of the $$ＤＥＭ$$ (Dimension Energy Machinery) series, a line of $$次元力$$-use mobile weapons developed by $$ＤＥＭコーポレーション$$. Its model number is $$ＤＥＭ$$-03.
It was caught in a dimensional quake during testing and descended to Earth together with $$ＡＧ$$, an agent robot of $$ＤＥＭコーポレーション$$.
It was originally single-seat, but a seat for a navigator was installed, converting it to a two-seater.
It was developed with an emphasis on the first stage of $$次元力$$ use, as a power source, aiming to be the ultimate general-purpose unit able to perform at its best in any environment.
It is equipped with the tactical system and next-generation $$次元力$$ control mechanism 'TS-DEMON,' along with a variety of weaponry suited to any combat range and the 'D-Fault' defense mechanism that makes use of dimensional faults, resulting in a unit with a good balance of offense and defense.
It also has a transformation mechanism into the aggressive 'GAI Mode,' which reflects the pilot's mental state. Even $$ＡＧ$$ had not been informed of this function, but as data was gathered through battle, the conditions for its activation were gradually worked out.
284.DSC2:
The final completed form of the $$ＤＥＭ$$ (Diabolus Ex Machina) series, a line of $$次元力$$-use mobile weapons developed by $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$.
Its model number, $$ＤＥＭ$$-03, signifies that it is a unit that follows '00: $$レムレース$$ Prototype,' '01: $$レムレース$$,' and '02: $$カオス・レムレース$$,' which $$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$ of the $$ＵＣＷ$$ developed in the past.
It was operated under the pretense that it had been caught in a dimensional quake during testing and descended to Earth together with $$ＡＧ$$, an agent robot of $$ＤＥＭコーポレーション$$.
Its original pilot was $$西条涼音$$, who carries the factor of $$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$, but an accident forced a change of plans, and even so, in order to have her board it, a seat for a navigator was installed, converting it to a two-seater.
It was developed with an emphasis on the first stage of $$次元力$$ use, as a power source, aiming to be the ultimate general-purpose unit able to perform at its best in any environment.

Reflecting the pilot's mental state, it has a mechanism to transform into the aggressive 'GAI Mode' and further to metamorphose into its final form, '$$ジェミニオン・レイ$$.'

285.DSCR:
The form $$ジェニオン$$ takes when it activates 'GAI Mode.'
'GAI' stands for 'Glitter Armament Infinity,' a name given by $$ＡＧ$$.
Its existence was not known even to the agent $$ＡＧ$$, and its first activation came about almost by accident.
The pilot's mental state is involved in triggering it. This is thought to be because $$ジェニオン$$'s 'TS-DEMON' must shift into what could be called a second stage, a mode that goes beyond simple control of $$次元力$$ to sense the pilot's emotions and will, and draw out $$次元力$$ through them.
Unlike $$ジェニオン$$, which only used $$次元力$$ as a power source, GAI Mode actively diverts $$次元力$$'s greatest characteristic, phenomenon control, into its weaponry. As a result, its combat strength surpasses $$ジェニオン$$'s, boasting overwhelming destructive power.
At first, the $$次元力$$ drawn out by the second-stage TS-DEMON had a quantitative limit, and this form could be maintained for only about one to two minutes. However, once it seized the $$スフィア$$ of the $$いがみ合う双子$$ from $$ジェミニア#robot$$, this problem was resolved. Furthermore, thanks to the pilot's qualities as a Reactor, TS-DEMON was able to control the $$スフィア$$, raising the unit's combat strength beyond what it had ever been.

Its appearance closely resembles that of $$ジェミニア#robot$$, developed on Planet $$ジェミナイ$$, suggesting some connection between the two. $$ＡＧ$$ described this as a deliberate case of convergent evolution (the phenomenon whereby things sharing similar properties also come to resemble each other in form) aimed at seizing the $$スフィア$$ of the $$いがみ合う双子$$. The fact that a $$スフィア$$ was seized at all, something thought only possible between $$スフィア・リアクター$$s, is itself strong evidence that the seizure of the $$いがみ合う双子$$' $$スフィア$$ was this unit's very purpose in being developed.

286.DSCR:
The final form of $$ジェニオン$$.
The change from $$ジェニオン$$ to $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$ was a pure transformation, but this one is a metamorphosis, with changes occurring that ignore mass and other constraints.
It did not become the 'Diabolus Ex Machina' (Clockwork Devil) that $$ＡＧ$$ had envisioned, but is a unit that reflects the pilot's will. $$ＡＧ$$ had intended to name it '$$ジェミニオン$$,' but as something that went beyond that, it was named '$$ジェミニオン・レイ$$.'
It is a unit for bringing out to the fullest the power of the $$スフィア$$ of the $$いがみ合う双子$$, which has awakened to the Third Stage, and each of its weapons is inherited from $$ジェニオン$$'s. This means that what in $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$ was tossed about by the overabundant energy of the $$スフィア$$ and stayed at the level of giving it directionality and releasing it can now be used as a more refined weapon.
For that reason, more precise phenomenon control has become possible, and it boasts overwhelming combat strength surpassing $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$'s.

287.DSCR:
A unit refitted from $$バルゴラ$$, which had been developed as a prototype for the Earth Federation Forces' next-generation mass-production unit.
It was developed to operate the all-range general-purpose armament system '$$ガナリー・カーバー$$.'
The base unit, $$バルゴラ$$, had a flexible joint structure and high responsiveness that met the demands of every pilot from rookies to veterans, but the servo motors and actuators of each joint were tuned by Dr. $$ジエー・ベイベル$$ of $$カイメラ$$, and the VWFS (V-Wing Flight System) further made flight within the atmosphere possible, giving it astonishing mobility.
Furthermore, booster pods intended to boost the output of the VWFS were added by the $$サイデリアル$$ researchers who obtained this unit, greatly increasing its top speed.
Also, the $$サイデリアル$$, who are at a far higher level than Earth in $$スフィア$$ research, added a $$スフィア$$ control system to the $$ガナリー・カーバー$$. This was to draw out $$次元力$$ more efficiently and at the same time convey the user's will directly to the $$スフィア$$, and it succeeded in unifying the $$スフィア$$ and its pilot $$セツコ$$ more than ever, drawing out extraordinary attack power.
Note that Earth-derived technology was actively used in this refit, and it is speculated that the $$サイデリアル$$ side tried out the Earth weapon technology they had obtained.
Note that the 'S' in its name stands for 'Star,' and was given by its pilot $$セツコ$$ as the very pride of '$$グローリー・スター$$.'

288.DSCR:
A repair machine of $$ビーター・サービス$$.
Its original main pilot was $$シエロ・ビーター$$, but $$ランド$$ now serves as the replacement.
Using the various tools equipped across its body and the giant hand-held tool '$$ライアット・ジャレンチ$$,' it handles repairs of all kinds of machines, from small units to large ships.
It also displays tremendous power in combat, so when a major battle breaks out, $$ビーター・サービス$$ is often hired as bodyguards.
The cockpit is a two-seater, and though small, it also has living facilities, making it both an important tool of the trade and a home for $$ビーター・サービス$$.
Through the awakening of the '$$傷だらけの獅子$$' and the will of $$ガンレオン$$, it can now be used in Magna Mode at all times, its whole body wrapped in a flame-like aura. $$メール$$, who rides in it, complains about the heat (though it is actually something different from real flame...), but $$ランド$$ likes this added function very much.
Note that when $$ランド$$ is not aboard, Magna Mode is released, so no problems occur inside the hangar.

289.DSCR:
The final completed form of $$リ・ブラスタ$$, integrating the 'Red' for close combat and the 'Blue' for ranged combat, and an experimental unit that attempts an entirely new approach.
The 'T' in its name means 'Trial.'
Since its basic tactical concept follows that of the ranged-combat $$ブルー$$, its main weapon is the 'AX-99 RAPTOR (New Electromagnetic Accelerator Gun Precision Test Model for Next-Generation Weapons Research),' fitted with a miniaturized 'SPIGOT (Spatial Probability Region Interferer for Object Movement and Transformation).'
At the same time, to make use of the data gained from the 'Red,' its frontal armor and joints have been reinforced, and it can also handle close combat.
This goes against the previous version's concept of strengthening combat power by narrowing down tactical uses, but it is a fusion of the direction of actively reflecting the $$スフィア$$'s phenomenon control in its weaponry and the direction of actively making use of the fighting style of the all-rounder $$クロウ$$, and as a result it was completed as a unit that, on paper, displays combat strength exceeding both the Red and the $$ブルー$$ in every situation.
However, because output was increased to cover the added weight compared with the $$ブルー$$, it turned out to be a hard-to-handle unit whose speed improved but whose course changes became difficult, and even higher piloting ability is demanded of $$クロウ$$.
Also, to fully bring out the power of the $$スフィア$$ of the $$揺れる天秤$$, it is equipped with the 'CDS (Coin Drop System)' as in the previous version.

290.DSCR:
A spacetime control system developed for the purpose of operating the $$Ｚクリスタル$$.
It takes the form of a battleship in order to carry the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ into the battlefield and protect it from enemy attacks, but the name '$$ソーラリアン$$' properly refers to its system unit.
Under the direction of $$トライア・スコート$$ and $$ＡＧ$$, it can be called a crystallization of Earth's wisdom, with various researchers cooperating, each in their own field of expertise.
It brings together the finest hyperspacetime physics conceivable today, and $$次元力$$ is used in many places, from its weaponry to its drive system.
However, its true value lies only in phenomenon control by the $$Ｚクリスタル$$, and its pure combat ability is not high. To make up for that shortcoming, it always keeps an escort force, and protects the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ in coordination with them.

Now that the consciousness of $$エスター$$, who played the core role in the true evolution fusion at $$カオス・コスモス$$ and is also in charge of controlling the $$Ｚクリスタル$$, has returned, it can draw out $$次元力$$ more directly, and the Hyperdimensional Transfer Cannon, its greatest firepower, has also become usable.
Though different in scale, its existence is the same as the $$至高神ソル$$ worshiped by the $$御使い$$s, and if humanity's true evolution and research on $$ソーラリアン$$ advance, there is a possibility that a similar system could be completed.
After the hyperspacetime restoration, it lost the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ and its role ended, but it went into service on a new mission as a Gate Traveler.

292.DSCR:
A mobile weapon piloted by $$ガドライト#pilot$$ of $$ジェミニス$$.
It carried the $$スフィア$$ of the $$いがみ合う双子$$.
It was developed for $$ガドライト#pilot$$, the strongest pilot on Planet $$ジェミナイ$$, and brings together $$ジェミナイ$$'s finest technology. The $$スフィア$$ fitted to it at that time was still under analysis at first, but once $$ガドライト#pilot$$ awakened as a Reactor, its various functions were unraveled and $$ジェミニア#robot$$ was completed.
Its base design follows on from $$ディオスク$$, sharing the same psychokinetic control interface, light-particle-based weaponry, and high melee performance. However, combining these with $$ガドライト#pilot$$'s powerful psychokinetic ability, his outstanding piloting skill, and the $$スフィア$$'s $$次元力$$ produces overwhelming combat strength. By calculation, its fighting power is equal to a whole battalion of $$ディオスク$$ units.
In the decisive battle after the $$時空修復$$, the $$スフィア$$ of the $$いがみ合う双子$$ was seized from it by $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$, and it was defeated.
$$アムブリエル$$, who had become one of the $$サイデリアル$$, boarded the unit after recovering it, and, the reverse of the $$時獄戦役$$, challenged $$ジェニオン$$ to a fight to seize the $$いがみ合う双子$$ mounted on it.

293.DSCR:
A mass-produced mobile weapon used by $$ジェミニス$$, which belonged to the interstellar military alliance $$サイデリアル$$.
A weapon developed on Planet $$ジェミナイ$$, this high-grade unit was issued on a priority basis to $$ジェミニス$$, the elite corps.
It employs a man-machine interface called psychokinetic control, through which a $$ジェミニス$$ member's psychokinetic power is applied directly to piloting. Because of this, each unit is finely tuned to match its pilot.
By using its various weapons, which draw on light particles extracted through $$次元力$$, with the high responsiveness and mobility afforded by psychokinetic control, it possesses tremendous melee ability. In particular, 'Command Arts,' which reproduces $$ジェミナイ$$'s traditional martial arts through the unit itself, is extremely effective in mobile weapon combat, and $$ディオスク$$, which puts it into practice, stood alongside $$ジェミニア#robot$$ as a symbol of strength to the $$ジェミナイド$$s.
$$アムブリエル$$, who boarded $$ジェミニア#robot$$, used the units left behind in the $$サイデリアル$$ as her own underlings. Because AI was used as the pilot in that case, the psychokinetic control function, its greatest feature, was cut, and its combat strength is lower than when piloted by $$ジェミニス$$ members.

proofread.reason: pronoun: Ambriel is female (brief); the name was repeated only because of the old gender rule (the second $$アムブリエル$$ token is dropped for that reason)

294.DSCR:
A humanoid mobile weapon used by the interstellar military alliance $$サイデリアル$$.
It is mainly used with manned piloting.
The unit is built with flexible armor plating covering a movable frame. This armor is fitted with a mechanism for releasing energy to the outside, and can transform as needed to be used as a weapon as well.
It boasts high mobility that makes the most of its frame structure and high-output weaponry, giving it combat strength that sets it apart from weapons of Earth manufacture.

299.DSCR:
A mobile weapon directly under the $$御使い$$s.
In appearance it is no different from an $$アンゲロイ$$ apart from its black armor, but by directly using the power of the $$源理$$ (= $$次元力$$), it boasts overwhelming sturdiness, and by calculation amounts to more than 30 times the combat strength of a standard-issue $$アンゲロイ$$.
The standard-issue $$アンゲロイ$$ are cheap copies of this unit, and only a $$真徒$$ chosen by the $$御使い$$s is permitted to board it.
In the history of the universe, it is a legendary unit that appeared on battlefields where the $$サイデリアル$$ was struggling and trampled resistance forces with overwhelming power, and extremely few know of its existence. At the same time, such a person senses the overwhelming presence that owns this unit, and is forever assailed by boundless awe.

300.DSCR:
A mass-produced mobile weapon used by the $$サイデリアル$$.
It is basically unmanned, controlled by an AI.
At first glance it looks frail, but thanks to its simple structure and a design that gives no consideration whatsoever to pilot safety, it can shrug off a fair amount of damage, giving it high durability.
Its offensive power is inferior to the $$アンゲロイ$$'s, but combined with the durability described above and tactics based on numbers, it becomes a considerable threat.

uncertain: robot 259/263/260: 疑似シン化第１形態 rendered 'Pseudo-Shinka First Form' and 獣化第２形態 'Beastified Second Form' (also 'beastifies' in 265) with 裏コード = 'secret code' 'The Beast'; no wiki source for official English.

robot 259 DSC2: the Jigoku English rendered 使徒が展開する絶対不可侵領域 as 'absolute territory'; I restored the dropped 不可侵 ('absolutely inviolable territory') and changed 'weak points' to 'other targets' (Japanese says コアなど). Everything else in the Jigoku sentences kept.

robot 264 and others: the glossary English for 第１０の使徒 is '10th Angel' (no 'the', unlike 'the Fourth Angel'); I wrote 'the $$第１０の使徒$$' so it reads 'the 10th Angel'. If the orchestrator changes it to 'the Tenth Angel', the article in my text must be removed. 264's own prose says 'The tenth Angel' in lower case like the Jigoku entries for the other Angels.
robot 260: header sentence is literal (no token) as in Jigoku, because the Japanese omits 先行量産機 that the RBN2 token has. Jigoku 'a real Evangelion' quote punctuation kept.
robot 262: added 'also' (ダミープラグに切り替えられた際にも) which the Jigoku English lacked.

robot 273: 装甲を破って: whose armor is not stated; I wrote 'tore through the armor' keeping the ambiguity. Jigoku 'broke free of its restraints' and 'crushed between its teeth' were not in the Japanese and were dropped.
robot 269: Jigoku English embellishments (landing blow after blow, still failed to defeat Unit-01) are not in the Tengoku Japanese and were dropped; the head armor destroyed is taken to be Unit-01's.

robot 274/277: Jigoku sentences kept, except two fixes: ラクシャータ設計のバイク式 = 'motorcycle-style type designed by' (Jigoku said 'favors'), and the 'anyone other than Lelouch' sentence now reads 'even if ... can pilot it, they cannot bring out its full performance'. ブリタニア系 rendered '$$ブリタニア$$-line designs' because 'Britannian' cannot be built from the token.

robot 278/279: 'Pilot Support and Enlightenment Interface System', 'Gravity Weiver', 'Neuro Plus Powered', 'Thunder Giant' (雷の巨人) and 'Sea of Mist' (霧の海) are my own renderings; the local wiki sources give no English for them. 'Gravity Weiver' may be the official 'Gravity Weiver'/'Gravity Waver'. Used $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$ for the creature since the #keyword variant is pending.
robot 282: 波乗りロブスター rendered 'Wave-Riding Lobster' (nickname, no wiki source).

robot 284/285/286: DSC2 of 284 gives ＤＥＭ as 'Diabolus Ex Machina' (DSCR says Dimension Energy Machinery); レムレース rendered 'Lemures', 機械仕掛けの悪魔 'Clockwork Devil'. 285 DSC2 has no 'existence not known even to AG' paragraph (the Japanese DSC2 drops it), so I did not include it. Jigoku's '$$スフィア$$ Reactors' became $$スフィア・リアクター$$s. The token 至高神Ｚ has the odd glossary English 'Supreme God Z / Hypsistos Z'; kept as the token.

robot 286/290: 超時空修復 written as the plain phrase 'hyperspacetime restoration' as in kw_000 (not a token); 真化融合 and 人類の真化 written as 'true evolution fusion' and 'humanity's true evolution' (no token; official English unknown; possibly 'Shinka'). カオス・コスモス made a token 'Chaos Cosmos'. 超次元転移砲 'Hyperdimensional Transfer Cannon' and ゲートトラベラー 'Gate Traveler' left as plain phrases.

robot 288: glossary says 傷だらけの獅子 = Wounded Lion (confirmed) while kw_000 proposes 'Scarred Lion'; I used the token. ライアット・ジャレンチ tokenized as 'Riot Jarrenchi' (romanization guess); Ganary Carver and FLEIJA Eliminator tokenized to match kw_045.
robot 289: 逆恨み的に不機嫌になる者が若干一名 rendered 'exactly one person grew unreasonably sulky' without naming who. SPIGOT/AX-99 RAPTOR expansions translated from the Japanese; the official English is unknown.

robot 292/293: ジェミニス is the group, so I wrote '$$ジェミニス$$' and '$$ジェミニス$$ member' rather than Jigoku's 'Geminiss' (plural s on the token); the same for the elite corps. Ambriel's gender is unknown, so the name is repeated ('Ambriel's own underlings') and 'boarded the unit'. In 292 DSCR, 'the reverse of the Time's Prison War' is my reading of 時獄戦役とは逆に (he/she went to seize the Sphere this time, instead of having it taken); ジェニオン (not ジェニオン・ガイ) kept as in the Japanese.
robot 287/288/289: アドヴェントのプレッシャー rendered 'the pressure of Advent' with the #pilot token; 反作用の一部 in 288/289 = 'part of its backlash', 287 = 'its backlash'. 'Glory Star' quoted with the token.
robot 297: ハイアデス is both the unit/special forces name and the person who loves アルデバル; gender unknown so 'alter ego' construction used; only a keyword token exists for it.
robot 299: 源理 tokenized as 'Origin Law' (assumed to be the kanji form of オリジン・ロー); 真徒 proposed 'True Disciple', used singular because of the token; 御使い = 'Envoy' (kw_000 proposal).
robot 291: グラーティア級 = '$$グラーティア$$-class' (glossary Gratia is a robot entry).

Tokenized names not in the sheet (Geofront, Lake Ashi, Matsushiro, Sagami Bay, Black Knights, Britannia, Gawain, Lancelot, Percival, Damocles, Tristan Divider, Lemures etc.) follow the Jigoku English spellings; all listed in names.
robot 265: the 'γ' type written as the 'gamma' type to stay ASCII (the glossary English for the unit keeps the Greek letter).
